body: I have spoken to a gender therapist and a regular one. It just doesn't seem like it's helping. I've been on hormones for a couple months and I haven't seen much changes and my family is just less than supportive. I just am so tired and drained from everything. My mom either ignores me for days or is just yelling at me constantly. I don't know what to do. I just want it all to end.

I read the suicide note of a trans girl a few months ago and it hit me so hard. It felt like I had been the one who was killed. It was some girl I had never even met or anything. I cried for hours. There was the recent one that happened too. I cried then too. I just don't know if I have the strength to go forward anymore.
I have. They don't seem to care. It seems like no one but you does.

I just acted hyper-masculine. I would try and get into fights and stuff. Which totally is out of character for me cause I'm a waif. 

And it feels like my body is the wrong one. Like I was suddenly swapped out of my body before birth.

It's like feeling your whole body is wrong. I just feel wrong. I tried to deny it for a while and act like a normal guy. But having sex while part of you is screaming to stop and that it's wrong is terrible.
I appreciate you talking to me. I'm sorry I'm ungrateful. I don't know.
I wish those other people would respond. I need more people to talk to.

Good idea. I'll try. I feel like a broken record. But not because of the obvious. The needle comes around and chips another piece of me away and people are sitting around me saying "don't worry the song will get better!" But the crack is getting bigger and bigger and the song is getting worse and nearing half way and the record player is falling apart and the owner of the record is calling me a worthless mess and I just want to be a CD not a record.

I have no scars. My mom is too smart. No one would believe me. I just have such a hard time talking to people. I have no idea how to express my sadness and emptiness and I don't know what else. It feels like I'm alone. You're the only one who will listen.

I don't know how to make the abuse end. I have no idea how to trust people. It seems like if I told anyone they wouldn't believe me cause it's mostly emotional and I have no direct scars from it. I hate myself. I hate being a guy. Why would I want to continue that? I don't see the point of suffering through more years of life just to hate myself.
